annotations.title: Property · Hazard by mesh block — flood, bushfire, erosion, slope within 1 km (by gnaf_id)

description:
**Is it exposed to flood, fire or erosion?** For every mesh block around the property: whether the block sits inside flood planning, flood overlay, bushfire-prone or erosion-prone areas, risk scores for flood, fire, coast and ground movement, and the slope of its homes. A flag is null where we do not hold that layer for the state (bushfire: Queensland; flood planning: NSW; flood overlay: Queensland), so null means unknown, not clear.

One entry per mesh block within 1,000 m of the property under `mesh_blocks`, nearest first, each with its `mb_code`, `distance_m`, `population` and `dwellings`. Blocks across suburb lines are included. Values only — the polygons come from `/properties/{gnaf_id}/context/mesh-blocks`.

Every field carries `provenance` — `measured` (at this block), `measured_wider_area` (measured for the SA1 or postcode and repeated on every block in it), `estimate` (our model) or `not_recorded` (not labelled yet) — plus `how`, one sentence on how the number was arrived at (empty when `not_recorded`).

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
